title: Target Seat Price of a Professional Email Pro Upgrade
content:
Billing desk schedule. The target seat price of a Professional Email Pro upgrade is read from the billing plan and the calendar months of the term on the subscription record.

| Billing plan and term | Target seat price (USD per seat per month) |
|---|---|
| annual billed monthly, a 12-month term billed monthly | 23.10, Microsoft 365 Business Premium's annual-billed-monthly price |
| monthly, a term of one calendar month | 7.49 for Harborline Mail Pro, or 26.40 for Microsoft 365 Business Premium — the month-to-month price above the annual commitment |
| otherwise | the target product's annual-commitment price: 5.99 for Harborline Mail Pro, 22.00 for Microsoft 365 Business Premium |

These figures hold the target product's own seat prices.

Examples (hypothetical): a Harborline Mail Plus subscription on the monthly plan over a one-month term moving up to Harborline Mail Pro takes a target seat price of 7.49; a Microsoft 365 Business Basic subscription on the annual-billed-monthly plan over a 12-month term takes 23.10.
